Paths to the example plate photographs shipped with FunMel

Source: R/example_plate.R
example_plate.Rd

Two real photographs of Zymoseptoria tritici (four colonies per dish), reduced to 1000 px for size:

"confrontation"

four colonies around a central interacting fungus with spreading growth (original: 2026_05_26_20.JPG).

"control"

four colonies without an interacting partner (original: 2026_05_26_37.JPG).

Usage

example_plate(type = c("confrontation", "control", "all"))

Arguments

type

"confrontation", "control" or "all".

Value

File path(s).

Examples

example_plate("control")
#>                                                                                                                        control 
#> "/private/var/folders/f1/f8pqw4_n4y90tlykbbhy3ztm0000gn/T/RtmpVEPw2F/temp_libpath43343f9aa15e/FunMel/extdata/zymo_control.jpg" 
# \donttest{
res <- analyze_plate(example_plate("control"), layout = plate_layout(centre = "none"))
#> ℹ Reading image
#> ℹ Detecting dish
